احتجما (form VIII)

# اُحْتُجِمَا (uḥtujimā) /uħ.tu.d͡ʒi.maː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِحْتَجَمَ (iḥtajama)
# اِحْتَجِمَا (iḥtajimā) /iħ.ta.d͡ʒi.maː/: second-person dual imperative of اِحْتَجَمَ (iḥtajama)
